plugins.name: day-trader-skill
plugins.description: Eleven Claude skills for day trading on the NSE with Zerodha: a chart scanner, a news monitor, an entry timer, an exit planner, a time machine that replays 10,000 sessions, a risk manager, a budget manager (Zerodha MIS margin and charges), an order ticket and trade log, price alerts with desktop notifications, an earnings analyst and a bulk/block deals and insider tracker.
